fixtures.note: Chattanooga does not amend the toilet-count table, the half-and-half split, rounding, the urinal rule or the small-occupancy exceptions: neither Ordinance No. 13924 (plumbing) nor Ordinance No. 13921 (building) touches Section 403 / Chapter 29, Section 405.3 or Section 424.2. Chattanooga is on the 2018 edition while the state is on 2021. The office, restaurant and school ratios, the 50/50 split, rounding up, the 15-or-fewer and 25-or-fewer exceptions and the 50% and 67% urinal limits read the same in both, so the state pack's worked examples hold. What differs: the 2018 text has no provision for a shared (multi-user) all-gender room, which the 2021 text added; in 2018 separate facilities for each sex are required apart from the listed exceptions, and single-user rooms are 'identified for use by either sex'.

quotes.split_and_rounding: To determine the occupant load of each sex, the total occupant load shall be divided in half. ... Fractional numbers resulting from applying the fixture ratios of Table 403.1 shall be rounded up to the next whole number.
quotes.urinals: In each bathroom or toilet room, urinals shall not be substituted for more than 67 percent of the required water closets in assembly and educational occupancies. Urinals shall not be substituted for more than 50 percent of the required water closets in all other occupancies.
quotes.separate_facilities: Where plumbing fixtures are required, separate facilities shall be provided for each sex. Exceptions: Separate facilities shall not be required for dwelling units and sleeping units. Separate facilities shall not be required in structures or tenant spaces with a total occupant load, including both employees and customers, of 15 or fewer. Separate facilities shall not be required in mercantile occupancies in which the maximum occupant load is 100 or fewer. Separate facilities shall not be required in business occupancies in which the maximum occupant load is 25 or fewer.
quotes.compartments: Each water closet utilized by the public or employees shall occupy a separate compartment with walls or partitions and a door enclosing the fixtures to ensure privacy.
quotes.urinal_partitions: Each urinal utilized by the public or employees shall occupy a separate area with walls or partitions to provide privacy. The horizontal dimension between walls or partitions at each urinal shall be not less than 30 inches (762 mm). The walls or partitions shall begin at a height not greater than 12 inches (305 mm) from and extend not less than 60 inches (1524 mm) above the finished floor surface.

worked_examples.how: 25 women, 25 men. 25 / 25 = 1 each. Urinals may replace at most 50% of 1 = 0.5, so 0.
50 each. First 50 at 1 per 25 = 2. Urinals: 50% of 2 = 1.
100 each. First 50 at 1 per 25 = 2, remaining 50 at 1 per 50 = 1, total 3. Urinals: 50% of 3 = 1.5, so 1.
200 each. First 50 = 2, remaining 150 at 1 per 50 = 3, total 5. Urinals: 50% of 5 = 2.5, so 2.
25 each. 25 / 75 = 0.33, rounded up to 1. Urinals: 67% of 1 = 0.67, so 0.
100 each. 100 / 75 = 1.33, rounded up to 2. Urinals: 67% of 2 = 1.34, so 1.
200 each. 200 / 75 = 2.67, rounded up to 3. Urinals: 67% of 3 = 2.01, so 2.

fixtures.worked_examples_note: Not amended by the city: these repeat the state pack's results, checked against the 2018 ratios Chattanooga enforces. Urinals are optional; the code does not say how the 50% and 67% limits round, and the examples round down.

page.meta: Commercial bathroom partitions delivered to Chattanooga job sites. Price your restroom, pick the right material and see the Chattanooga rules.
page.lead: Commercial bathroom partitions for Chattanooga offices, restaurants, manufacturing plants and visitor attractions, shipped by freight to your job site.
page.access_bullet: - **Wheelchair access:** a restroom with stalls needs at least one stall a wheelchair user can enter and use. Tennessee law uses the federal access standards as its own for public buildings. Chattanooga's building rules also apply a national accessibility standard, in its 2009 edition, and the plans are approved by the office that reviews the project.
page.fire_bullet: - **Fire safety:** Chattanooga's building rules require solid plastic (HDPE) partitions to pass a room fire test. Ask for the fire-rated version.
page.stall_bullet: - **How many stalls:** Chattanooga sets the number of toilets by how many people use the building. The table below shows what that means.
page.state_extra_bullet: - **Tennessee and federal stall rules match:** Tennessee adopted the federal standards word for word, so a stall, door or grab bar that meets one meets the other. The 2009 standard in Chattanooga's building rules is a separate document, so ask the Land Development Office which sizes it checks on your project.
page.restroom_bullet: - **Single-user and all-gender restrooms:** under Chattanooga's rules a one-person restroom is marked for use by either sex. Where toilets are required, the rules call for separate men's and women's rooms, except in small spaces. The edition Chattanooga enforces has no provision for a shared all-gender room with several stalls, so ask the Land Development Office before you plan one. Since July 2026, state law requires shared restrooms in public colleges and universities, state prisons, juvenile detention facilities and domestic violence shelters to be designated for females, males or families. A 2021 law covers shared restrooms in public schools.
page.permit_bullet: - **Permits:** Chattanooga requires a commercial building permit to alter or repair a commercial building. Its list of work that needs no permit includes painting, tiling, cabinets, countertops and similar finish work, and movable partitions no taller than 5 feet 9 inches. It doesn't name toilet partitions. Ask the Land Development Office (423-643-5894) whether your replacement needs one. You don't need a permit to buy partitions.
page.stalls_intro: Chattanooga counts toilets by a building's capacity: the most people it is designed to hold at one time, worked out from its floor area. It isn't the number of staff or of visitors in a day. Half are counted as men and half as women, and every toilet needs a stall with a door. Urinals are optional: in a men's room they may replace up to half of the toilets in an office and up to two thirds in a restaurant or school, each with a privacy screen. The table shows toilets only.
page.stalls_after: These are minimums for the whole building, and at least one stall in each room must be wheelchair accessible. An office for 25 people or fewer, or any space for 15 or fewer, may use one shared room. Chattanooga enforces an earlier edition of the rules than the state does, and these numbers are the same in both.
page.capacity: To find your building's capacity, the building rules count an office at one person per 150 square feet of floor, a restaurant dining room at one per 15 square feet and a classroom at one per 20. Your architect or the Land Development Office sets the final number.
skip_state_sources: Toilet counts under the state code
Fire test for solid plastic partitions: 2021
page.install_rule: Chattanooga's city code sets no general contractor license of its own, and permits come from the Land Development Office. Tennessee requires a state contractor license to bid or take commercial projects of $25,000 or more. Confirm what your project needs with the Land Development Office. You don't need a permit to buy partitions.
page.faq_install_extra: Chattanooga's city code sets no general contractor license of its own, and Tennessee requires a state contractor license for commercial projects of $25,000 or more.
page.public_jobs_bullet: - **Public jobs:** Tennessee's wage law for public work covers state highway projects only, so on a school or city building a set wage applies only where federal money brings in the federal wage rules. The federal rate for a carpenter on building work in Hamilton County is $18.00 an hour, with no benefits amount listed.
page.sales_tax_bullet: - **Sales tax:** 9.25% in Chattanooga: 7% state and 2.25% Hamilton County. The 2.25% local part applies only to the first $1,600 of the price of each single item, and the state adds 2.75% on the part of an item's price between $1,600 and $3,200.
page.buyers_extra: - **Visitor attractions, hotels and event venues:** HDPE or phenolic for restrooms that take big crowds and frequent cleaning.
